name: Weekly Inverse Volatility Portfolio
description: Volatility-scaled portfolio across SPY, TLT, GLD, and DBC. Weights are inversely proportional to each asset's 63-day realized volatility, rebalanced weekly. 200-day SMA trend filter: only hold an asset if price is above its 200-day SMA — if below, that allocation moves to cash (total exposure shrinks). Max single-asset weight capped at 50%.
source:
# Weekly Inverse Volatility Portfolio
# SPY, TLT, GLD, DBC — weighted by inverse of 63-day realized vol
# Rebalanced weekly, 100% fully invested, long-only

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# --- Volatility (63-day, annualized) ---
# volatility() takes close prices directly (internally computes returns + annualizes)
vol_63 = volatility(period=63)(close)

# --- Rebalance Detection ---
is_new_week = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.week)(index())

# --- 200-Day SMA Trend Filter ---
sma_200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)
above_sma = is_valid(sma_200) and close > sma_200

# --- Signal: Long only if above 200-day SMA ---
# Gate entry/exit to weekly rebalance dates
# Enter on rebalance if above SMA, exit on rebalance if below
enter_long = is_new_week and above_sma
exit_long = is_new_week and not above_sma
held = hold_until()(enter=enter_long, exit=exit_long)

# --- Inverse Volatility Weights ---
# Compute weights across ALL assets (always_active=True for all)
# Then zero out assets below SMA → their allocation goes to cash
always_active = True
inv_vol_wt = inv_vol_weight(max_weight=0.5)(active_mask=always_active, volatility=vol_63)

# Apply trend filter: assets below SMA get 0 weight (cash)
final_weight = inv_vol_wt.weight * (1.0 if held else 0.0)

# --- Execution ---
# Long-only: all assets always long
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)

# Size as percent of equity, rebalance only on weekly boundary
# Assets below SMA have final_weight=0 → cash position
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=final_weight * 100, rebalance_on=is_new_week)
